widgets.title: Local-first
widgets.source: This isolated dashboard uses synthetic checks. No personal accounts, telemetry or API keys are configured.

widgets.title: HomeLab workspace
widgets.source:
Visibility starts here

A private, reproducible starting point for your homelab. Services below are navigation examples, not claims that applications are installed.

widgets.title: Ownership and recovery
widgets.source:
Deliberate operations

Configuration is mounted read-only. Stop preserves files. Removal retains configuration and ownership history. Export settings before upgrades and validate recovery in a separate installation.

widgets.title: Not connected yet
widgets.source: Uptime Kuma, Beszel, host metrics, personal cloud insights and public access are separate milestones. This dashboard does not query the host or control Docker.
